' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND B.APP_ITEM = 'Y'),DistinctTags AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PR_CODE ORDER BY STK_DATE DESC, TAG_NO) AS rn FROM StockData WHERE rnTag = 1),GroupCount As(Select COUNT(DISTINCT PR_CODE) As TotalGroups FROM DistinctTags),RowLimit As (SELECT d.PR_CODE,CEILING(100 / g.TotalGroups) AS AllowedRows FROM (SELECT DISTINCT PR_CODE FROM DistinctTags) d CROSS JOIN GroupCount g) Select s.* FROM DistinctTags s JOIN RowLimit r On s.PR_CODE = r.PR_CODE WHERE s.rn <= r.AllowedRows ORDER BY s.PR_CODE, s.STK_DATE DESC, s.TAG_NO
